# Benchmarks

<!-- Generated by calling report() in rind's admin/bench-report on host JSON for any filesystem-safe host, including a CPU slug. This is not the repo's BENCHMARKS.md. -->

Side sheet for `pi5`, `m1pro`.

Times are criterion's estimates from `admin/bench-report run`. A host measured through host-run.py kept that script's operations, criterion arguments, parsing, and JSON, and recorded a busy host or a rustc other than the Nix pin instead of refusing them. The toolchain and the load are whatever each host's JSON records. A host run outside the Nix dev shell, or while other work was on the machine, says so in its note. A host the JSON marks noisy had other work during the run.

## Gaps on these hosts

Each operation where another library is more than 10% faster than rind, computed by `gaps_of` the way `admin/bench-report` computes gaps (`SLOWER` is 1.1). These are measurements. `benchmarks/gaps.toml` holds the maintainers' decisions for the hosts and nightly tiers it names, and this sheet does not read or write it.

| Operation | On | rind's time over the fastest |
|---|---|---|
| X25519 ECDH | `pi5` | 2.50× (aws-lc-rs) |
| AES-128-GCM, 32 B | `pi5` | 1.25× (OpenSSL) |
| AES-128-GCM, 32 B | `m1pro` | 1.11× (OpenSSL) |
